quests.title: Sell the Pub
quests.giver: Pádraig Ó Gallchóir, behind the bar
quests.summary: Pádraig is seventy-one and wants to sell the pub. A young couple, the community co-op and a hotelier each want it, and each would run it differently. Hear them all, then tell him straight.

steps.text: Hear Niamh, by the door with the high chair.
Hear Bríd of the community co-op, by the fire.
Hear Orla the hotelier, in the corner.
Tell Pádraig who you think should buy.
Wait for word. The parish post comes in at the pub, a night's sleep or a day later.

quests.reward: A Donegal tweed shawl, a keepsake from the pub, and Pádraig's mother's boxty recipe.

endings.text: Niamh and Ciarán took the pub on as a pub with a kitchen. The snug is gone, the Tuesday session stays, and the first January decides it.
The community co-op bought the pub: three hundred and forty shares and a rota. It opens four nights, and the Sunday session is fuller than it ever was.
Orla's hotel took the pub on as a bar with six rooms. It is open every day of the year, with local staff, and it is not Pádraig's any more.
